title: Erroll Garner fired from Charlie Parker's group
summary: Garner was fired at the Three Deuces and next week had his own trio with Parker as guest.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Charlie Parker: encounters, lore and legacy

blocks.x: Did you never have anything... Didn't you play with any Bebop musicians?
I did in the Bebop places. Erroll and I played in the Bebop places. But Erroll was not a Bebop piano player. As a matter of fact, he was fired from Charlie Parker's group.
Erroll. Erroll Garner. At the Three Deuces.

And then the next week there Erroll had his own trio, and Charlie Parker was guest on his... That's the way the ball went, you know. Erroll just had too much talent. That was really not his bag of tricks. And he didn't conform to the basic pattern of Jazz and Bebop Jazz at that time.
